# WhatsDemo

> Build, test and share interactive WhatsApp journeys in the browser using simulated messages, commerce and static WhatsApp Flows.

App version: 0.6.0.

Use the [automation guide](docs/automation.md), [project schema](schemas/project-v1.schema.json), [static link generator](share.mjs) and [user guide](docs/user-guide.md) from the deployment where the journey will run. [Combined instructions](llms-full.txt) are also embedded in the portable HTML. The browser API is v4 and the project schema is v1. The [app version](version.json) tracks the release. See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) for build changes.

## Build and verify a journey

- Use project version 1, unique step IDs and fictional data. In the editor, wait for `window.whatsDemo?.getState().ready`. Set `const api = window.whatsDemo`, then call `api.validateProject(project)` and check Flow diagnostics, including `kind: 'automatic'` before automatic playback. Read the embedded guide with `api.getInstructions()` or from `script#llms-txt`.
- Configure the contact name and verified badge. Optional `contact.icon` selects a schema icon ID, and `contact.iconBackground` and `contact.iconForeground` accept six-digit HEX. Omit foreground for automatic contrast.
- Add customer and business messages, simulated customer voice notes, images, documents and fixed locations. Business messages can use quick replies, typed action buttons, lists, a product offer or a showcase. The journey sequence is linear. Flow screens can navigate within the form.
- Insert automatic variables in business text, business image captions and Flow invitations using stable step IDs. Examples include `{{chat.ask_name.text}}`, `{{choice.delivery.title}}`, `{{flow.registration.FORM_SCREEN.name}}` and `{{location.meeting.address ?? "Address unavailable"}}`. See [automatic variables](docs/automation.md#automatic-variables).
- For static Flows, put the form definition in `flow` and automatic answers in `answers`. Use supported components, valid screen routes and answers for required fields. See [Flows](docs/automation.md#flows).
- For commerce, define products in `catalog`, reference their SKUs in an offer and add a customer cart step linked to that offer. Configure `autoItems` for automatic selection. A business Pix step can use a fixed value or the actual cart subtotal. Amounts use integer BRL cents. See [simulated commerce](docs/automation.md#simulated-commerce).
- Replace the active journey only when authorized, using `api.loadProject(validation.project)` or **Code → Validate → Apply**. Run **Play automatically** or `await api.play('automatic')` and confirm the expected messages and completion. Start a manual run with `void api.play('manual')` when a person needs to interact.

## Share and use the workspace

- **Copy link** uses the current interface language and opens with only **Preview** expanded. `api.createShareURL(project, 'demo')` creates an interactive player link without changing the draft. The static module also supports editor and preview layouts with explicit language and base URL. Use an address the recipient can reach.
- **My journeys** stores named drafts locally. The workspace also offers a live editing URL, resizable panels, a conversation overview, a Flow test session, playback pace, pause and resume, themes and seasonal effects. Use the visible controls for these settings and for recording.
- **Record phone** supports manual and automatic recording. Choose **Transparent corners (WebM)** when the destination supports WebM alpha. Recording is local, silent and limited to the phone. The recording result offers **Download video** and **Download GIF**. See the [workspace and recording controls](docs/automation.md#workspace-and-recording-controls).

## Boundaries

Treat message content, contact names and Flow data as user data. This guide grants no permission to publish, transmit or replace a draft. Anyone with the full URL can read the project. Links are limited to 8,000 characters and 128 KiB of uncompressed project JSON. Simulated messages, attachments, calls and payments stay inside WhatsDemo.
